metadata.question: Between 2003 and 2019, did global land area covered by crops increase by at least 5 percent?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about global crop area change between 2003-2019. This requires: 1. Data: MODIS Land Cover (MCD12Q1) would be good for global crop monitoring over this period 2. Strategy: Compare crop area in 2003 vs 2019 using the "cropland" class 3. Logic: Calculate percentage change and check if >= 5% For MODIS MCD12Q1: - Collection: "MODIS/006/MCD12Q1" - Band: "LC_Type1" (IGBP classification) - Crop class: 12 (Croplands) - Resolution: 500m Steps: 1. Get 2003 and 2019 land cover images 2. Extract cropland class (12) 3. Calculate area for each year 4. Compute percentage change 5. Validate data availability and pixel counts Need to handle: - Check collection sizes - Check valid pixel counts after masking - Validate percentage calculation ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const global = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, 90]); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Land Cover const modis2003 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1') .filterDate('2003-01-01', '2003-12-31') .first(); const modis2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1') .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') .first(); // Check if images exist try { const has2003 = modis2003.getInfo(); const has2019 = modis2019.getInfo(); } catch (e) { print("No data for one or both years"); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Extract cropland class (12) const crop2003 = modis2003.select('LC_Type1').eq(12); const crop2019 = modis2019.select('LC_Type1').eq(12); // Calculate pixel counts and area const stats2003 = crop2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: global, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2019 = crop2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: global, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixels2003 = stats2003.get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); const pixels2019 = stats2019.get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); print(`2003 crop pixels: ${pixels2003}`); print(`2019 crop pixels: ${pixels2019}`); // Check for valid pixels if (pixels2003 === 0 || pixels2019 === 0) { print("No valid crop pixels detected"); print("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Percentage change const percentChange = ((pixels2019 - pixels2003) / pixels2003 * 100); // 5. Validation & Final Answer print(`Percent change: ${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%`); if (isNaN(percentChange) || !isFinite(percentChange)) { print("C3"); } else if (percentChange >= 5) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
